statement: On the operation_workflow_owner's dispatching node, HELD_BY_OTHER at the operation-ledger self-move engagement point is an authoritative read, never a memory: when the locally registered holder id differs from the engaging self-move, engagement resolves the holder through the existing lifecycle relation (tryClearHeldOperationLedgerSelfMove: a positive authoritative terminal row of the holder releases it, a live holder keeps refusing, unresolved reads hold), and a local failOperation/terminal settlement of the holder clears its own registration, so a re-planned ledger self-move after a failed-stale predecessor claims SENDING on its first engagement attempt once the predecessor's terminal row exists instead of parking held_by_other until teardown. IDLE_ONLY, exclusion once engaged, terminal-only release (no release on age, reservation reconciliation, null or failed reads), quorum_concentrated deferral, PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS, the drain's stale rules, budgets and cadences, the 60-second certification window and the single cluster-ACTIVE authority are unchanged. Proven by the real-owner witness failed-holder-does-not-starve-successor on the hold-fairness fixture: red on HEAD (successor parks held_by_other on every attempt, ledger spread never satisfies inside 60 s), green after (successor SENDING on the first attempt after the predecessor's terminal row; hold-engagement and hold-fairness witnesses stay green). Root cause from GCP run 2026-08-30T04-49-12 (replace-op-691efb46 drain-failed stale on n1 at 04:52:48.6; successor replace-op-4f30c060 parked held_by_other 41 times 04:52:57.4-04:53:45.7; barrierReleased false). Second seal (v2): v1 is frozen superseded history carrying a mixed-base attempt pair (its step was pinned at 7085090e2 before the stale-quest triage commit 0553f8b10 and its one-shot attempt was recorded at 0553f8b10), so no single recorded common Git base exists in the v1 frame; the candidate bytes are identical and are recorded here once at the current base.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The operation_workflow_owner (rebalance-coordinator-ledger-interlock-hold-state.js, operation-ledger-hold-policy.js, operation-workflow-dispatch-ledger-self-move-gate.js, the interlock admission lanes) stays the sole owner of hold registration, engagement, and release; the drain, reservation reconciliation, planners and the harness never release a hold.

A hold is released only by a positive authoritative terminal row of the holder itself (or the local terminal settlement of that same holder); null, failed, deferred reads, age, and reservation reconciliation never release it; two ledger self-moves are never non-terminal at once.

IDLE_ONLY, exclusion once engaged, quorum_concentrated, PENDING_TIMEOUT_MS and the drain stale rules, DISPATCH_RETRY_DELAY_MS, the 60-second GCP certification window and the failed-repair backoff are unchanged. No sleeps or timeout widening.

Prove through the hold-fairness real-owner witness fixture (virtual clock, run-cited latencies) red on HEAD and green after, before any GCP run; the GCP streak is certification, never an iteration loop.
Do not make the harness, analyzer, or readiness owner derive cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.
